headline: DET @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 5.06 at HOU 4.54, with a projected total of 9.60. The projected total climbed +1.40, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Troy Melton has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 4 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yordan Alvarez, Gleyber Torres, Christian Walker, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Christian Vázquez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
